links.comparator_used: Baseline LLMs (Qwen3, GPT-4.1, Grok-3) answering without RAG
links.outcome: Accuracy on lung cancer guideline questions (50 questions)
links.effect: RAG significantly improved accuracy, with statistical differences versus baseline LLMs. Baseline accuracy was GPT 48%, Grok 44%, Qwen 40%. The abstract does not give RAG accuracy figures.
links.quote: However, implementing RAG (LLM-RAG) or MCP (LLM-MCP) significantly improved accuracy, with statistical differences observed between baseline LLMs and their RAG- or MCP-enhanced counterparts.

links.comparator_used: Baseline LLMs (Qwen3, GPT-4.1, Grok-3) answering without MCP access to an external knowledge base
links.outcome: Accuracy on lung cancer guideline questions (50 questions)
links.effect: MCP significantly improved accuracy, with statistical differences versus baseline LLMs. Baseline accuracy was GPT 48%, Grok 44%, Qwen 40%. The abstract does not give MCP accuracy figures. Responses also had less lexical richness and semantic noise, and more semantic clarity.
links.quote: The integration of RAG or MCP significantly enhanced accuracy while simplifying sentence structure, focusing more on the main topics, and using more accurate vocabulary.

design_hint: retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) and Model Context Protocol (MCP)
